output.review_comment: The implementation correctly fixes the function to pass all tests. The three changes (weight > 20.0 validation, tier comparison logic from <= to <, and rounding with + 0.5) are all legitimate bug fixes that align with the test specification. However, the docstring contains inaccurate descriptions of the weight tier boundaries, specifically claiming that weight "up to and including 2.0 kg" uses the 790 tier, when the tests clearly show 2.0 kg should use the 1290 tier. Please update the docstring to accurately reflect the actual tier logic: weight < 0.5 kg (450), 0.5 ≤ weight < 2.0 kg (790), 2.0 ≤ weight < 5.0 kg (1290), 5.0 ≤ weight ≤ 20.0 kg (2450).
